Work with BEAST2 packages from R.

Related packages:

- [babette](https://github.com/ropensci/babette) do a full BEAST2
  workflow.
- [beautier](https://github.com/ropensci/beautier) creates BEAST2 input
  (`.xml`) files.
- [beastier](https://github.com/ropensci/beastier) runs BEAST2
- [lumier](https://github.com/ropensci/lumier) helps to create the
  `babette` function call needed
- [tracerer](https://github.com/ropensci/tracerer) parses BEAST2 output
  (`.log`, `.trees`, etc) files.

Non-CRAN extensions:

- [beastierinstall](https://github.com/richelbilderbeek/beastierinstall)
  Install and uninstall BEAST2
- [mauricerinstall](https://github.com/richelbilderbeek/mauricerinstall)
  Install and uninstall BEAST2 packages

## Examples

To install the BEAST2 NS package:

``` r

remotes::install_github("richelbilderbeek/mauricerinstall")
mauricerinstall::install_beast2_pkg("NS")
```

An introduction video:

- [YouTube video about mauricer](https://youtu.be/Yk737gorcrw)

## Files used by continuous integration scripts

| Filename | Descriptions |
|----|----|
| [`mlc_config.json`](https://docs.ropensci.org/mauricer/mlc_config.json) | Configuration of the link checker, use `markdown-link-check --config mlc_config.json --quiet docs/**/*.md` to do link checking locally |
| [`.spellcheck.yml`](https://docs.ropensci.org/mauricer/.spellcheck.yml) | Configuration of the spell checker, use `pyspelling -c .spellcheck.yml` to do spellcheck locally |
| [`.wordlist.txt`](https://docs.ropensci.org/mauricer/.wordlist.txt) | Whitelisted words for the spell checker, use `pyspelling -c .spellcheck.yml` to do spellcheck locally |
| [`.markdownlint.jsonc`](https://docs.ropensci.org/mauricer/.markdownlint.jsonc) | Configuration of the Markdown linter, use `markdownlint "**/*.md"` to do markdown linting locally. The name of this file is a default name. |
| [`.markdownlintignore`](https://docs.ropensci.org/mauricer/.markdownlintignore) | Files ignored by the Markdown linter, use `markdownlint "**/*.md"` to do markdown linting locally. The name of this file is a default name. |

# Package index

## All functions

- [`default_params_doc()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/mauricer/reference/default_params_doc.md)
  : This function does nothing. It is intended to inherit is parameters'
  documentation.

- [`get_beast2_pkg_names()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/mauricer/reference/get_beast2_pkg_names.md)
  : Get all BEAST2 package names

- [`get_mrc_path()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/mauricer/reference/get_mrc_path.md)
  :

  Get the full path of a `mauricer` file

- [`get_mrc_paths()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/mauricer/reference/get_mrc_paths.md)
  :

  Get the full path of one or more `mauricer` files

- [`install_beast2_pkg()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/mauricer/reference/install_beast2_pkg.md)
  : Install a BEAST2 package

- [`is_beast2_ns_pkg_installed()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/mauricer/reference/is_beast2_ns_pkg_installed.md)
  : Is the BEAST2 NS package installed?

- [`is_beast2_pkg_installed()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/mauricer/reference/is_beast2_pkg_installed.md)
  : Is a BEAST2 package installed?

- [`uninstall_beast2_pkg()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/mauricer/reference/uninstall_beast2_pkg.md)
  : Uninstall a BEAST2 package
